scope.subject: Payroll web application APP-DEMO-07
objectives: Pay staff accurately and on time
Protect staff personal and bank details

assets.name: Payroll records and staff bank details

threats.name: Financially motivated cybercriminals exploiting internet-facing applications

evidence.text: CVE-2021-44228 is listed in the KEV fixture with known ransomware campaign use.
APP-DEMO-07 runs Apache Log4j 2.14.1 and is internet-facing.

risks.statement: Cybercriminals exploit the unpatched Log4j library in APP-DEMO-07 to run code, steal staff bank details and disrupt pay runs
risks.vulnerability: Apache Log4j 2.14.1 on an internet-facing host

controls.text: Patches for online services are applied within 48 hours when working exploits exist

risks.rationale: A known exploited vulnerability with ransomware use is present on an internet-facing host that holds critical personal information.

actions.text: Upgrade Log4j on APP-DEMO-07 to a fixed release
Hunt for exploitation of CVE-2021-44228 on APP-DEMO-07 since it was exposed

risks.statement: A payroll officer changes bank details to divert pay
risks.vulnerability: No second approval for bank detail changes
risks.rationale: Supplied context says changes need one approver only.

plan.goals: Keep payroll available and staff data confidential
plan.incident_management: Example Agency cyber incident response plan v3
